title: 1638 Prairie's lower south wing, built from its photograph
items: The block south of 1638 Prairie's gable in its photograph is the house's own wing, not the neighbour, and it is now built that way: a metre lower than the house, under a steep gable roof facing the street.
Its two upper windows and the lights below them stand where the photograph shows them.
The photograph puts the wing about 0.6 m wider than the 1911 fire-insurance map draws it; the photograph is followed and the difference is listed among the liberties.
